prompt: what is the most likely cause of the current inflation
response: The most likely cause of current inflation is an increase in aggregate demand outpacing aggregate supply, often referred to as demand-pull inflation. This can happen when there is too much money chasing too few goods, driving prices up. Other factors include supply chain disruptions and increased production costs, which can lead to cost-push inflation. However, demand-pull inflation is generally considered the primary driver in most cases.
